PM Modi Nitish Meeting : siyasat men rishte badalte hain... samikran badalte hain... lekin kuchh tasviren bahut kuchh bayan kar jati hain... patna eyarport par pradhanmantri narendr modi aur purv mukhyamantri nitish kumar ki mulakat ki tasviren bhi kuchh aisi hi hain... gale mile... hath thama... aur muskurakar ek-dusre ka abhivadan kiya... tasviren samne aaeen to phir charcha men aa gaee modi-nitish ki nanvar van jori...riport dekhie....
